entities.summary: Stephen Hough (b. 1961-11-22, Heswall) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Heswall and Australia. Known in the fields of australia, composers & musicians, oceania.
